notes: LS-SM311G-10C ordering: 1310nm, 1.25Gbps, LC, 10km, 0°C~+70°C, with DDM. Receiver sensitivity and overload measured with PRBS 2^7-1 @ 1250Mbps, BER ≤1×10^-12 (Note 3). Optical power launched into SMF (Note 1). Extended operating case -20 to +85°C and Industrial -40 to +85°C appear in Recommended Operating Conditions for other variants (e.g. LS-SM311G-10I). Supply current Icc max 300 mA at 3.135–3.465 V; power in watts not stated. SMSR row has no min/typ/max values. Diagnostic TX/RX power accuracy ±3 dB over stated ranges.
suggestions: Clarify whether receiver centre wavelength 1260–1610 nm should be modeled separately from transmitter 1260–1360 nm. post_fec_ber_target filled from sensitivity test BER note; no FEC is claimed on the module.
